payroll.name: Gusto
payroll.cta_primary_text: Compare Gusto True TCO & Claim $500 Switch Credit →
payroll.best_for: 1–50 W-2 employees in 1–3 US states seeking zero W-2 year-end filing fees
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Simple ($49+$6/pepm) covers 1 state; multi-state payroll requires Gusto Plus ($80+$12/pepm) or state tax registration add-on.

payroll.name: Rippling
payroll.cta_primary_text: Calculate Rippling Bundle & Unlock 3 Months Free →
payroll.best_for: 15–250 employees needing unified HRIS, IT device management, and automated multi-state SUI registration
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Advertised '$8/user/mo' requires mandatory Rippling Unity Core ($8/user/mo) plus $50/mo base minimum ($16/PEPM effective starting floor).

payroll.name: Deel
payroll.plan_name: Deel US Payroll + Global Contractor / EOR (2026)
payroll.cta_primary_text: Compare Deel All-State + EOR Rate ($750 Credit) →
payroll.best_for: Distributed teams with multi-state US W-2s + international contractors or EOR hires across 150+ countries
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: $0 base fee and all 50 US states included at $19/PEPM; watch 1.5%–2.5% cross-border FX spread on non-USD contractor payouts.

payroll.name: OnPay
payroll.best_for: 5–100 US employees across multiple states seeking flat $40 + $6/person pricing with zero extra state filing surcharges
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Unlimited multi-state filings included at $0 extra; $5/form W-2/1099 year-end delivery fee unless waived via partner promo.

payroll.name: ADP RUN
payroll.cta_primary_text: Audit ADP RUN Fee Schedule vs. Modern Alternatives →
payroll.best_for: Legacy SMB benchmark; often carries $35/mo per extra state jurisdiction and $65+$6.50/W-2 year-end filing fees
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Per-pay-run billing cycles (26 biweekly runs = 2 extra billing months/yr if not negotiated to monthly flat), $35/extra state/mo, and year-end W-2 package fees.

payroll.name: Paychex Flex
payroll.cta_primary_text: Audit Paychex Flex Year-End & Multi-State Fees →
payroll.best_for: Traditional SMB payroll comparison; watch $30/extra state tax filing fee and January W-2/1099 delivery charges
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Promotional 50% off for 6 months resets to full list + $60+$6/W-2 year-end tax form processing fee and $30/mo per extra state.

payroll.name: Justworks
payroll.cta_primary_text: Compare Justworks PEO All-State SUI Pool →
payroll.best_for: 10–100 employee teams wanting full PEO master-policy benefits and multi-state compliance under Justworks' FEIN
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Higher $59/PEPM base, and PEO co-employment restarts FUTA/SUI wage-base caps if switching mid-calendar-year (Q2–Q4).

payroll.name: QuickBooks Payroll
payroll.best_for: 1–20 single-state US employees already using QuickBooks Online accounting
payroll.hidden_fee_notes: Core charges $12/mo per additional state filing; automated local/city tax filings require upgrading to Elite ($130/mo + $11/PEPM).

merchant.name: Helcim
merchant.cta_primary_text: Switch to Helcim IC+ ($0 Monthly Fee + Automatic Volume Discounts) →
merchant.best_for: Merchants & B2B SaaS processing $15,000–$120,000/mo wanting true Interchange-Plus with $0 monthly account fee
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: $0 monthly fee, $0 PCI fee, and automatic volume margin drops at $25k, $50k, and $100k/mo.

merchant.name: Stax Pay
merchant.best_for: High-volume businesses processing $40,000–$500,000+/mo where 0% percentage markup saves $4,000–$28,000/yr over Stripe/Square
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: $99/mo subscription up to $150k/yr ($199/mo up to $500k/yr); passes exact wholesale Visa/MC interchange with 0.00% percentage markup.

merchant.name: PaymentCloud
merchant.cta_primary_text: Claim PaymentCloud B2B Level-3 Interchange Audit →
merchant.best_for: B2B invoicing, wholesalers, and high-ticket services ($500–$15,000 avg ticket) unlocking Visa/MC Level-2/Level-3 interchange reductions (-0.65%)
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: $15/mo gateway fee; automated Level-3 line-item data injection drops corporate/purchasing card wholesale interchange from 2.70% to ~1.90%.

merchant.name: CDGcommerce
merchant.best_for: US merchants processing $15,000–$100,000/mo with QuickBooks B2B invoicing integration
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: $0/mo under $10k volume, $49/mo IC+ tier for $10k–$100k/mo at IC + 0.25% + $0.10.

merchant.name: Stripe
merchant.cta_primary_text: See How Much You Overpay on Stripe 2.9%+$0.30 →
merchant.best_for: Early-stage startups processing <$10,000/mo before switching to Interchange-Plus
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: 2.9% + $0.30 base jumps to 3.3%–5.4% effective when adding Stripe Invoicing (+0.4%), Stripe Billing (+0.5%), and International Cards (+1.5% + 1.0% FX).

merchant.name: Square
merchant.best_for: In-person retail/food under $15,000/mo; expensive once keyed-in (3.5%+$0.15) or ACH/invoice volume scales
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: Square Invoices over $10k and manually keyed B2B cards (3.5% + $0.15) keep regulated $0.22 Durbin debit savings instead of passing them to the merchant.

merchant.name: PayPal Commercial / Braintree
merchant.best_for: Secondary consumer checkout button; highest B2B invoicing cost at 3.49% + $0.49 per invoice
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: PayPal digital wallet & invoicing charges 3.49% + $0.49 plus 1.50% cross-border and 3.0%–4.0% currency conversion spread.

merchant.name: Shopify Payments
merchant.best_for: DTC ecommerce brands; B2B wholesale invoices face a 2.0% third-party gateway penalty on Basic unless routed via offline/external invoicing
merchant.hidden_fee_notes: 2.9% + $0.30 on Basic ($39/mo); charges a 2.0% penalty on external payment gateways unless upgraded or invoiced externally.
